A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''holo-entertainer''' was particularly popular during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], but took a political stance against the Republic's policies in dealing with the Empire. Republic diplomats were able to convince him to retract his statements and keep quiet, resolving the matter.<ref name="TOR" />
